gate.rationale: v1 best single model reached 71.22 AP50. Matching it on the fresh lineage is the bar for the tube branch being usable.

notes: One of four experiments run concurrently, one per GPU. batch 16 with accumulation 2 keeps the effective batch at 32 so results stay comparable with the four-rank baseline.
one_variable: Tube-query decoder off -> on, with the v1 query stack and loss weights. Learning-rate multipliers deliberately set to 1.0 rather than the v1 value of 20, which was tuned against a base rate of 2e-6 and at our 1e-4 would be 2e-3.
purpose: Enable the tube-query decoder on the promoted distribution-head dense owner. All of WS1 ran with the tube branch off and therefore has no video metrics at all, yet AP20/AP50/AP50:95 are the actual SOTA targets. This establishes the video baseline every WS2 mechanism will be measured against.
